title: Canonical cohomology comparison and the Cech homology square
statement: Let R -> S be a flat algebra map, f:X -> Spec R separated, U a finite affine open cover, M quasi-coherent, and q a natural number; the notions and specific comparison beta are those of [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-proper-morphism], [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], [pqf-def-coherent], [pqf-def-cohomology], [def-pc-base-change], [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison], [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Using the Cech complexes and canonical-coordinate predicate from [lem-pc-flat-cech-base-change], let c be ANY chain map satisfying IsCechBaseChange; no invertibility of c is assumed. There exist R-linear and S-linear Leray isomorphisms e:Hq(COver(f,U,M)) -> HOver(f,M,q), eprime:Hq(COver(f_S,U_S,M_S)) -> HOver(f_S,M_S,q). After identifying the ordinary tensor with categorical extension of scalars by the proved extendScalarsTensorIso, beta equals extension of e inverse, followed by the canonical exact-tensor homology isomorphism of [lem-pc-flat-tensor-complex-cohom], followed by Hq(c), followed by eprime. In particular this is a commuting square, not an assertion that beta or c is invertible.

proof.text: Obtain the two Leray isomorphisms and their compatibility on original cycle classes; no flatness is required for this step.

The kernel and cokernel universal properties show that the exact-tensor homology isomorphism sends scalar extension of the class of a cycle to the class of its scalar extension. This is extendedCechCycles_homology, proved from mapCyclesIso, mapHomologyIso and naturality of homologyπ.

Cancel the tensor identification, scalar extension of e, and scalar extension of the epimorphism from cycles to homology. Tensor induction reduces the resulting equality to pure tensors b tensor z. S-linearity reduces it to 1 tensor z, where the cocycle compatibility applies. The defining pure-tensor formula of H.baseChange finishes.

theorem exists_cechBaseChange_cohomology_square [Module.Flat R S]
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of R)) [IsSeparated f] [Finite ι]
    (U : ι → X.Opens) (hU : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (U i)) (hcover : iSup U = ⊤)
    (M : X.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] (q : ℕ)
    (c : tensorCech (S := S) f U M ⟶
      cechOver (baseChangeSnd (S := S) f) (baseChangeCover (S := S) f U)
        (baseChangedModule (S := S) f M)) (hc : IsCechBaseChange f U M c) :
    ∃ e : (cechOver f U M).homology q ≅ ModuleCat.of R (HOver f M q),
    ∃ e' : (cechOver (baseChangeSnd (S := S) f) (baseChangeCover (S := S) f U)
        (baseChangedModule (S := S) f M)).homology q ≅
          ModuleCat.of S (HOver (baseChangeSnd (S := S) f)
            (baseChangedModule (S := S) f M) q),
      (extendScalarsTensorIso (S := S) (HOver f M q)).inv ≫
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap R S)).map e.inv ≫
        (flatCechHomologyIso (S := S) f U M q).hom ≫
        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap c q ≫ e'.hom =
          ModuleCat.ofHom (H.baseChange (S := S) f M q)
